mapper.sql:
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR)
AND p.pay_status = #{status}
AND pr.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')

WHERE ja.user_id = #{userId}
AND ja.app_step NOT IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표')
AND ja.app_step IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표')
AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND jp.close_date < CURDATE()
AND ( jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

WHERE r.person_user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = 1 AND bm.job_id IS NULL
AND jp.post_check = 2 AND jp.post_status = 1 AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE() AND ja2.job_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.user_name, u.phone, u.user_type, u.status, up.gender, up.birth_date, up.country, up.profile_url, up.pass_count, usp.remaining_count, usp.use_status, usp.product_id, p.product_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_person up ON u.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN user_product usp ON u.user_id = usp.user_id AND usp.use_status = 'active' LEFT JOIN product p ON usp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.email = #{sId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET withdrawn_at = now(), status = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE email = #{sId}
mapper.select: SELECT resume_id , user_id , title , status , hidden_job , hidden_industry , hidden_company_type , company_name , created_at , updated_at , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_str , is_deleted FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, resume_id DESC

SELECT cover_letter_idx , user_id , title , company_name , save_status AS status , created_at , DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str FROM cover_letter WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_bookmark jb INNER JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = jb.job_id INNER JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id WHERE jb.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND jp.close_date < CURDATE()
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja WHERE ja.user_id = jb.user_id AND ja.job_id = jb.job_id )

SELECT p.pay_id, p.user_id, p.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_date, '%y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS pay_date_text, p.pay_price, p.pay_status, p.pay_method, pr.product_name FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY p.pay_date DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.safeSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id

SELECT ja.app_id , ja.job_id , uc.company_name , jp.title , jp.exp_type , jp.exp_year , jp.edu , jp.emp_type , jp.address , jp.close_date , (jp.close_date < CURDATE()) AS closed , ja.app_step , DATE_FORMAT(ja.apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS apply_date_str , CASE WHEN ja.app_step IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표') THEN '최종발표' ELSE '지원완료' END AS status_label FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = ja.job_id JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id
ORDER BY jp.close_date ASC, ja.apply_date DESC
ORDER BY jp.close_date DESC, ja.apply_date DESC
ORDER BY ja.apply_date DESC, ja.app_id DESC
LIMIT #{page.offset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{page.safeSize, jdbcType=INTEGER}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = ja.job_id JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id

SELECT r.job_id , r.score , jp.title , jp.field , jp.address , jp.open_date , jp.close_date FROM RECOMMENDED_JOB r JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = r.job_id
LEFT JOIN job_bookmark bm ON bm.user_id = #{userId} AND bm.job_id = jp.job_id
LEFT JOIN JOB_APPLICATION ja2 ON ja2.job_id = jp.job_id AND ja2.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY jp.close_date ASC, r.score DESC
ORDER BY jp.open_date DESC, r.score DESC
ORDER BY r.score DESC, r.recommended_at DESC
LIMIT #{page.offset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{page.safeSize, jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_bookmark(user_id, job_id, reg_date) VALUES(#{userId}, #{jobId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(recommended_at) IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN MAX(recommended_at) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM RECOMMENDED_JOB WHERE person_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO RECOMMENDED_JOB (person_user_id, job_id, score, recommended_at, is_active) SELECT #{userId}, j.job_id, ( CASE WHEN tf.field IS NOT NULL THEN 30 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN j.open_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN j.close_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 10 ELSE 0 END ) AS score, NOW(), 1 FROM JOB_POSTING j
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.field FROM ( SELECT jp2.field, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_bookmark b2 JOIN JOB_POSTING jp2 ON jp2.job_id = b2.job_id WHERE b2.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY jp2.field ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3 ) x ) tf ON tf.field = j.field
LEFT JOIN job_bookmark bm ON bm.user_id = #{userId} AND bm.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE j.post_status = 1 AND j.close_date >= CURDATE() AND bm.job_id IS NULL
ORDER BY score DESC, j.open_date DESC LIMIT 50
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), recommended_at = VALUES(recommended_at), is_active = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT q.qna_id , q.qna_category , q.qna_title , q.qna_content , q.writer_id , q.reg_date , q.re_status , q.re_date , q.re_content , q.is_deleted , DATE_FORMAT(q.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_date_text , CASE WHEN q.re_status = 'completed' THEN '답변완료' ELSE '답변대기' END AS status_text FROM qna q
ORDER BY q.qna_id DESC LIMIT #{page.offset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{page.safeSize, jdbcType=INTEGER}
